# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to a respectful, inclusive, and constructive community for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and professional
- Give actionable, technical feedback
- Assume good intent and ask clarifying questions
- Keep discussions focused on improving the project

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, threats, or abusive language
- Personal attacks, discrimination, or hate speech
- Repeated off-topic disruption or bad-faith behavior
- Publishing private information without consent

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or restrict participation when behavior violates this policy.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the maintainers privately with context and evidence.
